events.verdict: Avdija (POR) legally contests Lillard's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Sharpe (POR) is firming up over his right leg in Green's (MIL) path when Green moves into the pick and marginal contact occurs.
Green (MIL) avoids making illegal contact with Sharpe's (POR) arm during his contest of the jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Camara (POR) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Milwaukee.
Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arms momentarily come around Camara's (POR) right arm as they come together during the pick and the marginal contact dissipates shortly thereafter.
Portis' (MIL) arm, although slightly outstretched, absorbs the oncoming contact while defending Camara's (POR) drive to the basket and shot attempt, the contact is consider marginal.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) firms up over his right leg and marginal contact occurs as Camara defends over the pick.

Replay review of the foul called on Ayton (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Ayton steps to his left and turns his body into Antetokounmpo (MIL), delivering contact that affects his layup attempt at the basket.
Portis (MIL) jumps along Simons' (POR) path and makes marginal body contact while defending the shot attempt at the rim.
Camara's (POR) right hand momentarily brushes Antetokounmpo's (MIL) waist as the two players disengage from the pick and the contact is marginal.
Ayton (POR) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Milwaukee.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Lillard (MIL) makes last contact with the ball prior to it going out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Portland.
Jackson Jr. (MIL) reaches in for the ball and makes illegal contact with Simons' (POR) arm, which impacts his control of the ball.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) firms up over his right leg and marginal contact occurs as Camara (POR) defends over the screen.

Simons (POR)  is alongside Lillard (MIL) when the offensive player elevates for his jump shot attempt. Simons then steps back behind Lillard during his contest and Lillard extends his right leg backwards while in the air. The contact during the jump shot attempt is marginal and was not imminent prior to Lillard raising his right leg backwards into Simons unnaturally on his shooting motion.

Portis (MIL) brings his left arm towards the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Camara's (POR) head/face prior the release of his pass. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
